versions.changelog:
paper-reading-problem-reality-check v0.1.0

- Initial release of the Problem Reality Check skill for inspecting Research Question Cards.
- Adds a structured workflow to interrogate whether a research problem is real, evidence-backed, externally grounded, and safely motivated.
- Introduces stepwise Challenge Question interrogation across six Reality Check Dimensions, requiring turn-by-turn user interaction.
- Ensures only one Research Question Card is routed and checked per run, enforcing strict card selection and evidence inspection rules.
- Outputs detailed reports and transcripts under a dedicated research-question-checks workspace.
- Does not perform method critique, experiment design, or initiate new literature searches by default; focuses solely on problem motivation validity.
